The '''Hapuntep system''' was a part of the [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] known as the [[Crown Prince of Hapuntep]].<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Hapuntep [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-17.<ref name="TEA" />
